$comment: /account fragment: data export and account deletion (GDPR). Merged with en.json at load time.

account.export_body: Everything Harvester stores about you, as JSON: profile, settings, farm and plots, inventory, animals, buildings, bank, progression, companions, co-op, integrations, auction house and your last {transactions} ledger entries.
account.export_truncated: ⚠️ Sections emptied to respect the maximum file size: {sections}.
account.export_privacy: Only you can see this message. API keys and webhook secrets are never included: only their prefixes and URLs. You can export again in one hour.
account.delete_body: This action is **irreversible**. Your farm, plots, animals, inventory, progression, coins and gems will be lost for good. Consider `/account export` first if you want to keep a copy.
account.delete_effects:
What happens right away:
• Your username is replaced by an anonymous identifier, display name and avatar are erased.
• Your settings are neutralised: no more notifications, farm set to private.
• Your API keys are revoked and your webhooks deleted.
• Your standing buy orders are cancelled.
• You leave your co-op.
account.delete_keeps: The ledger (your transactions) is kept for the audit of the game economy, tied to an internal identifier: it is neither public nor visible in the game.
account.delete_expires: This button stays valid for {minutes} minutes. If you ever come back, `/start` will create a brand-new farm.
account.deleted_body:
Your account has been deleted. API keys revoked: {apiKeys} · webhooks deleted: {webhooks} · orders cancelled: {orders}.
Thank you for playing. If you ever feel like it again, `/start` is waiting.
account.cancelled_body: Nothing was changed. Your farm is waiting for you.
account.expired_body: This button is no longer valid. Run `/account delete` again if you still want to delete your account.

account.blocked:
Your account cannot be deleted yet. Settle the following first:
• {reasons}
account.blocker_listings: {count} active auction listing(s): `/auction cancel`, or wait for them to close
account.blocker_trades: {count} trade(s) in progress: cancel them from the trade message
account.blocker_coop_owner: you lead the co-op {name}: hand over the lead with `/coop promote`
